shortDescription: McDonald’s Corp. is trying to win back cost-conscious diners who say its menu has become too expensive, according to Bloomberg. The company faces that challenge as it works to revive a sagging stock price.

title: McDonald’s Shares Sink 30% as Big Mac Inflation Triggers Backlash
